newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Bandits seize guns in raid on Moldova army base.
newsitem.headline: Bandits seize guns in raid on Moldova army base.

text.p: Bandits made off with more than 30 Kalashnikov automatic rifles in a daring raid on a military base in Moldova, police said late on Monday.
Several masked men broke into a former Soviet army barracks occupied by forces of the breakaway Dnestr region on Sunday. They dropped some of the guns as they made their escape in the darkness.
The barracks is in the ancient fortress town of Bendery, on the Dnestr river, which is administered jointly by Moldovan and Transdnestr officials and Russian peacekeepers.

"Apparently, the stolen Kalashnikov submachine guns were stolen by a group of Dnestr gangsters to settle scores with rivals from other criminal groups," Bendery's Moldovan police commissioner Valery Prudnikov told Reuters.

Gang warfare has become endemic in the economically blighted Dnestr region, which is not recognised internationally. Its mainly Slav population of 70,000 broke away in 1990 fearing the Romanian-speaking majority wanted to merge with Romania.
Fighting in 1992 was quelled by Russian troops led by Alexander Lebed, the recently sacked Kremlin security chief.
